system_directory.missing_behavior_sources: Serializer algorithms, defaults, fuel, inventory consumption/remainders and UI interactions; special recipes and smithing trim cannot be reconstructed from missing result fields.
Advancement persistence/display/runtime semantics and all underlying action mechanics. Recipe-unlock advancements overlap recipe concepts and are not independent score leaves.

Tag membership, effect interpreters, loot-table interactions, enchanting/anvil acquisition and runtime behavior. Fortune lacks an effects field here; this does not establish absence of its effect. Source selection weight is not E01 score.

Health, hunger, saturation/exhaustion, nutrition/eating conditions, sleep eligibility, time skipping and hostile-spawn interactions. Related advancement predicates are not definitions of these mechanics.
Damage computation and timing, equipment durability, projectile behavior, target AI, boss phases, death/drops and combat interactions. Kill-trigger conditions do not specify how combat works.
Growth/light/hydration, breeding foods and cooldowns, taming, pathfinding, spawning/despawning and mob-specific behavior. Trigger names and registry identities are insufficient.

Signal propagation, update order/ticks, comparator modes, pistons, block events, inventories, hoppers, dispensers and cross-system automation. Crafting a component does not define its circuit behavior.
Seed/noise/chunk generation, biome and structure placement, terrain/fluid behavior, loot and exploration interactions. A location criterion is not a world-generation specification.
Portal construction, coordinate/linking/search rules, dimension travel, return paths and progression dependencies. Observing a dimension transition does not define these mechanics.
Input, movement/collision, swimming/climbing/flying, gravity, vehicles, rails and passenger behavior; travel criteria and boat recipes do not define them.
Versioned offers, professions/workstations, prices, restocking, reputation, villages, raids and optional trade-rebalance applicability. No trade-rule body was collected.
Mode/difficulty rules, Hardcore, Creative, Adventure, Spectator, menus/input/accessibility, player interaction, synchronization and server rules. No mode is excluded by this missing source coverage.
Time/weather, player/world persistence, death/respawn, save/exit/reload and recovery. The continuous E01 play route remains undefined and untested.

scoring.reason: Source resource names are not unique observable acceptance leaves; no complete behavior baseline or independent freeze exists.

gaps.evidence: Registry IDs and data file paths do not enumerate all gameplay behaviors. A bounded increment now projects 1290 recipe, 1399 advancement and 42 enchantment definitions from three pinned 1.21.1 JSON blobs; these are partial data rules, not a complete gameplay baseline. Wiki page revision metadata was retrieved; its revision-content request remains HTTP 403 and was not retried.
gaps.missing: Version-applicable full behavior/manual source index and source-to-behavior coverage, including survival, physics, AI, redstone, progression, modes, multiplayer and save/reload.

gaps.evidence: summary.json lists all 54 data definitions absent from their corresponding empty registry arrays: 34 worldgen structures, 13 structure tags and 7 experimental structure tags.
gaps.missing: Independent confirmation against the exact original version; zero-length extracted registries must not remove these content concepts.

gaps.evidence: Catalog includes resource concepts, assets, internal types, variants and metadata; raw row counts would double-count or distort gameplay contribution.
gaps.missing: Stable acceptance leaf IDs, one behavior owner, uniform positive integer weight rationale, exact acceptance steps, system grouping and fixed full denominator.

gaps.evidence: Both bundled optional experiment packs are retained in separate catalog categories; no full mode/feature-flag applicability audit was performed.
gaps.missing: Documented version-applicable mode boundaries and source-backed inclusion or exclusion decisions, without reducing the game to a convenient subset.

gaps.evidence: No gameplay acceptance was run or claimed.
gaps.missing: Complete major-system gates and a frozen new-game-to-progression-to-save-to-reload continuous route with inputs and observable failure conditions.

gaps.evidence: The prior source-only catalog projection and the partial versioned data-rule source/field projection have independent review. Neither establishes full-game completeness, a frozen content baseline or scoring; all mcmeta views share one upstream extraction.
gaps.missing: Non-author source coverage, granularity, weights and critical-gate review before formal freezing.

gaps.evidence: D28 and preceding platform capabilities are not fully accepted; this source preparation did not execute a platform game project.
gaps.missing: Accepted platform, locked game environment, platform Project/Task/Agent/Execution/review/Artifact links, actual implementation, evidence manifest and replay/playtest.
